claim: Chinese phones drown in marketing SMS, so the two or three genuinely urgent texts a year — move your illegally parked car, the hospital is calling your number, the courier's final delivery attempt — are the ones people miss. The only real workaround is a hobbyist forwarding app that needs Magisk to stay alive.
method: Mined the open issue tracker of SmsForwarder (27.3k stars), a Chinese SMS-forwarding utility used by ordinary phone owners, for first-hand descriptions of what they actually need; cross-read the maintainer's OEM-survival issues to size the geek tax.
does: SmsForwarder watches incoming SMS, calls and app notifications on an Android phone and relays them, by user-written rules, to DingTalk / WeCom / Feishu / Bark / Telegram bots.
edge: It is the only widely used thing in China that treats 'this particular message must reach me, wherever I am' as a first-class rule rather than a notification setting.
why_use: Chinese mobile numbers receive dozens of marketing texts a day. The handful that carry a real deadline look identical in the notification shade, and the cost of missing one is concrete: a towed car, a forfeited hospital slot, a parcel returned to sender.
gap: Only geeks can use it: requires Magisk and technical setup, no consumer product around the capability.
counter: Carriers and OEMs could ship this as a system feature tomorrow, and Chinese ROMs already do crude SMS categorisation. SMS is also a declining channel — the same urgent notices increasingly arrive via WeChat service accounts, so a text-only product may be aimed at a shrinking surface.
differentiator: Do not build a forwarding engine; build triage that needs zero configuration. One job: classify each message as 'has a deadline and a cost' or not, then escalate the rare true ones by voice call or repeated alarm instead of another silent banner. Classification runs on-device so the body never leaves the phone. Cold start (Chinese): the SmsForwarder issue tracker and its 27k stargazers, who are already describing the scenarios, plus Xiaohongshu searches for 挪车短信 没看到 and 医院叫号 错过. Cold start (English): r/AndroidQuestions and r/tasker, search 'urgent SMS alert override silent'.
value: A one-time paid Android utility; the buyer is a car owner or parent who has already lost money to one missed message.
risk: Android SMS-read permission keeps tightening and store review for SMS access is hostile; distribution may be sideload or OEM-store only.

voices.quote: 想要一个可以针对接收到短信时，通过设置手机号或者内容进行语音播报的功能。经常把车停路边，如果有交警挪车的短信过来，可以语音我让我赶紧过去挪车
希望增加对小米手机（HyperOS / 澎湃OS）无人值守运行的支持。目前在小米设备开启锁屏密码后，设备重启第一次未解锁时，应用无法正常自动启动

zh.claim: 中国人的手机被营销短信淹没，于是一年里真正要命的那两三条——交警挪车、医院叫到你的号、快递最后一次投递——恰恰是被错过的那几条。现在唯一的解法是一个要靠 Magisk 保活的极客转发工具。
zh.does: SmsForwarder 监控安卓手机的短信、来电和 App 通知，按用户自己写的规则转发到钉钉／企业微信／飞书／Bark／Telegram 机器人。
zh.why_good: SmsForwarder 监控短信来电和通知，按规则转发到各种机器人渠道，是国内这件事上用得最广的工具。
zh.why_use: 国内号码一天几十条营销短信，真正带截止时间的那几条在通知栏里长得一模一样，而漏掉的代价很具体：车被拖走、号白挂了、快递退回。
zh.gap: 只有极客用得了。装它要选机器人渠道、挂 webhook，还要按维护者自己 issue 里写的那样跟小米/一加的省电策略斗、用 Magisk 保活。普通车主永远走不完这套。而「读我的短信、判断哪两条要紧、用我躲不掉的方式喊我」这个只干一件事的版本，没人做。
zh.counter: 运营商和手机厂商明天就能把它做成系统功能，国产 ROM 已经在做粗糙的短信分类；而且短信本身在萎缩，同样的紧急通知越来越多走微信服务号，只做短信可能是在一个正在缩小的口子上下注。
zh.differentiator: 不做转发引擎，做零配置的分诊。只干一件事：判断每条消息「有没有截止时间和代价」，真正要紧的那几条用打电话或连续闹铃喊你，而不是再来一条静默横幅。分类全程在手机本地跑，短信内容不出设备。冷启动（中文）：SmsForwarder 的 issue 区和它 2.7 万 star 用户——这些人已经在替你描述场景；再加小红书搜「挪车短信 没看到」「医院叫号 错过」。冷启动（英文）：r/AndroidQuestions 与 r/tasker 搜 urgent SMS alert override silent。
zh.value: 一次性买断的安卓小工具；买家是已经因为漏看一条短信真金白银吃过亏的车主或家长。
zh.risk: 安卓读短信权限越收越紧，应用商店对短信权限审核不友好，可能只能走侧载或厂商商店。
zh.hook: 我把车停路边，交警发短信让我挪车，等我看到的时候车已经被拖走了。

consumer_angle: A simple app that automatically forwards urgent SMS (parking fines, hospital calls, courier) to a loud alarm or voice call, with zero setup for non-technical users.
pick_reason: Verified pain from real users, clear gap in usability, and a solo-founder-friendly wedge.
